meta.title: Interests Explorations
meta.subtitle: I'm interested in 3D representation, which shapes how 3D scenes can be reasoned about and generated. I came here the long way around, through cybersecurity, cloud, and graphics.

entries.heading: ML & CV
entries.content: Started in computer graphics, now building foundations in deep learning and computer vision. Looking toward 3D representation and generation.

entries.heading: Computer Graphics
entries.content: Explored the 3D graphics rendering pipeline through OpenGL and GLSL shader programming. Worked with spatial transformations, lighting models and texture mapping to build a more concrete low-level programming foundation.

entries.heading: Cyber Security & Cloud
entries.content: Explored cloud computing with a focus on security practices and infrastructure deployment on AWS.

entries.heading: Cyber Security
entries.content: Focused on web security fundamentals and participated in CTF competitions to sharpen practical problem-solving skills.

entries.heading: The Beginning: Logic & OOP Foundations
entries.content: Started my software engineering journey with C++, learning the fundamentals of logic and object-oriented programming.
